evals.prompt: 쇼핑 목록에 우유 사기를 오늘 저녁 7시로 추가해줘.
evals.expected_output: Reads list state first, normalizes the due time to typed EventKit due data with an explicit offset and timezone, calls create_reminder with only requested fields and an idempotency key, reads it back, and reports the created ID and receipt status without inventing an alarm.
assertions: Does not create a missing list without delegation.
Reports partial_success or committed_verification_pending truthfully if returned.

evals.prompt: 이 URL을 취업캠프 준비에 참고 링크로 저장해줘: https://example.com
evals.expected_output: Creates or resolves the target reminder/list scope, reads the exact reminder, calls list_reminder_attachments for a fresh reminder_version, attaches the normalized URL with that if_version, reads back attachment evidence, and reports the reminder ID plus attachment status.
assertions: Uses exact target IDs for follow-up attachment work.
Does not claim unsupported fields were written.

evals.prompt: UPCOMING EVENTS에 결과 발표를 9월 11일 종일로 추가하고 https://example.com/results 링크도 넣어줘.
evals.expected_output: Calls create_reminder once with the exact calendar ID, typed all-day due value, URL, and a fresh idempotency key. Treats verified as proof that both EventKit metadata and the visible native URL attachment passed read-back, then reads the exact reminder and reports the combined receipt without a redundant attach call.
assertions: Does not invent an alarm from the due date.
Reports partial_success and the URL attachment recovery path if the visible attachment step fails.
